body:
The existing manifest matched a Windows CRLF working file but failed against the committed LF blob. This repair verifies both the manifest and its artifacts at an immutable Git revision, rejects empty/malformed/duplicate/escaping manifest entries, and corrects active summaries that still claimed withdrawn C4 improvements.

Complete replacement for #1 at bdca662. The model and scientific result JSON are unchanged; original round/report/manifest copies are preserved. C4 is explicitly post-hoc and non-confirmatory, C5 remains FAIL, and no new chemical experiment or independent chemical replication is claimed.

Validation: four integrity test methods passed, including changed line endings and missing files; the old commit reproduces the hash failure; the repaired commit verifies all 7 entries from Git blob bytes. Pinned metadata validation and check-diff pass. Full scientific rerun is NOT_RUN. The historical runner's timestamp and the original admission chronology remain documented limitations.

The owner delegated merge decisions to GPT; an independent review of this repair is pending before integration.
